connector.name: Knowa
connector.registryDescription: Team docs served to AI agents over MCP - search, Markdown reads, version pinning, read audit.
connector.summary: Hosted at app.knowalabs.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.knowalabs, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <API key>. Create a read-only key at app.knowalabs.com under Settings → Organization → API keys (format: Bearer knowa_sk_…).
